settings.heading: One simple capsule a day
settings.body: No needles, no fuss. Take your NAD+ capsule daily with water as part of your morning routine. Consistency is what turns it into real, lasting results.

Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (NAD+) is a vital coenzyme found in every living cell, driving energy metabolism, DNA repair and cellular communication. As we age, NAD+ levels naturally decline, which can show up as fatigue, slower recovery and visible signs of ageing.

These liposomal capsules wrap NAD+ in a protective lipid layer, so more of it survives digestion and reaches your cells, an easy daily way to top up your levels.
settings.insight: NAD+ powers the sirtuin and PARP enzymes that regulate cellular repair, inflammation and gene expression. Raising NAD+ availability has been shown to mimic the effects of caloric restriction, extending cellular lifespan and improving metabolic resilience.

settings.heading: Absorption you can rely on
settings.body: Standard NAD+ is largely broken down in the gut. Liposomal encapsulation shields it through digestion, so more of every dose is actually absorbed and put to work.

settings.note: For adult use only. Take as directed. Consult your practitioner before starting if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or managing a health condition.

settings.quote: Energy, brightness, clarity, and if I have a drink, I don't get hangovers anymore. Genuinely one of my favourite things we stock.

settings.a: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a coenzyme found in every cell, essential for turning food into cellular energy, repairing DNA and supporting healthy ageing. Levels fall as we get older.

settings.q: How soon will I feel a difference?
settings.a: Many people notice more energy and clarity within the first couple of weeks. NAD+ works best taken consistently every day.

settings.q: How many capsules should I take?
settings.a: One capsule daily with water, ideally in the morning. Take consistently for best results.
Liposomal encapsulation wraps NAD+ in a protective lipid layer so more survives digestion and is absorbed, compared with standard oral supplements.
Simply swallow one capsule with water. No food is required, though many people prefer to take it with breakfast.
Keep them somewhere cool and dry, out of direct sunlight, with the lid closed.

settings.q: Who is NAD+ not suitable for?
settings.a: Not suitable for anyone under 18, or with an allergy to any ingredient. Please speak to your doctor first if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have a serious health condition.
